---
title: Blank before header
---

# Real Section

Prose that opens a paragraph.
## Phantom Section
more prose in the same paragraph

## Genuine Section

Quarto renders this document with exactly two headings — `Real Section` and
`Genuine Section`. `## Phantom Section` is pressed against the line above it, so
pandoc's `blank_before_header` makes it paragraph text, not a heading.

***
# Below A Thematic Break

A thematic break is block-level, so this heading is real even with no blank line
above it. It is the control that fails if the rule is written as bare adjacency.
